crime_description: Hacking the city's traffic light system to cause massive gridlock. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside city planner, ideological goals, and offshore accounts.

suspect.name: Kelsey Suzuki
suspect.fake_alibi: Kelsey claims she was stuck in the very traffic jam she created.

secrets.value: A rogue city planner who provided Kelsey with the system's access codes.
Kelsey is an eco-activist protesting the city's reliance on automobiles.
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
